title: Skillet Apple Brownie
description: This is a warm, chewy skillet apple dessert with a brownie-like texture. Served in a cast iron pan, it’s an impressive presentation, perfect for company. Serve with ice cream.
ingredients: 2 cups apples - peeled, cored and chopped

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Place an 8- or 9-inch cast iron skillet into the oven to preheat.
Whisk together flour, white sugar, brown sugar, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves in a bowl; set aside.

Beat together eggs, vanilla extract, and melted butter in a mixing bowl. Toss apples and pecans in the flour mixture, then stir into the egg mixture until combined. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in the preheated skillet, swirling to coat the pan.

Pour the batter into the hot pan, and replace into the oven. Bake until the sides are dry and a toothpick inserted into the center of the brownie comes out clean, about 40 minutes. Cool in the skillet for 20 minutes before removing and slicing.

video.description: When you want a brownie that tastes like apple pie, you’ll find your happiness here. Simply preheat your skillet while you mix together flour, sugar, brown sugar, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves. Toss apples and pecans in the flour mixture, then stir into a mixture of eggs, vanilla and melted butter. Melt a pat of butter in the cast iron pan, swirling for good measure, then pour in your apple-infused batter. Bake until beautifully golden and your kitchen smells like autumn!
